notes: Surface labels (Customer/Staff/Developer/Agent) were moved out of the 'Surface' group to top level: Linear enforces one-label-per-group, and 53 issues legitimately span two or three surfaces. The empty 'Surface' group label remains (nothing is ever deleted).

An interrupted first import run created 7 partial issues (PAP-6..PAP-12) before the Surface-label error. They were not deleted (per instruction): each was marked state Duplicate and linked as a duplicate of its canonical issue (PAP-13..PAP-19).

12 project icons from plan.json (GitBranch, Palette, CheckCircle, Kanban, Bot, FileText, MessageSquare, Keyboard, Table, DollarSign, Download, Package) are not in Linear's icon set. Projects were created without an icon, then updated with the nearest valid Linear icon: Server, Paint, Wrench, Calendar, Robot, Search, Chat, Cursor, Spreadsheet, Dollar, Cube, Box.

pap5.title: My issue is that the startup procedure for creating new apps on the fly. Is inefficient. How quickly do we get from blank screen down the layers of abstraction to the electrons flowing through the circuits???
